newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets tender for hydropower project.
newsitem.headline: China sets tender for hydropower project.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it has called an international tender for the supply of electrical power equipment for a hydropower project in the southern province of Hunan.

Authorities were seeking nine generator voltage distribution devices and five transformers for the Lingjingtan hydropower project, officials of the China Electric Power Technology Import and Export Corp said.
They gave no estimate of the likely value of the contract. The tender would close on June 16.
The generators for the hydropower plant in Yuanshui had already been bought and the project was expected to be in operation after 2000, they said.
Further details were not immediately available.
